Maharashtra CM Orders Probe into Siddhivinayak Temple Donation Irregularities

Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis has ordered an investigation into alleged donation irregularities at Mumbai's Siddhivinayak Temple. The probe follows claims of an Rs 18 crore annual theft from temple donations. The investigation will reportedly examine the temple's records for the past five years, from 2022 to 2026. The order was issued after allegations were raised concerning the temple's financial dealings.
